package cacher

import sieve "sieve.client"

type Event struct {
	Type   string
	Key    string
	Object interface{}
}
type watchCache struct {
	seen   int
	last   string
	values []interface{}
}

func (w *watchCache) processEvent(event Event) error {
	w.seen++
	key := event.Key
	obj := event.Object
	_ = obj
	w.last = key
	defer sieve.NotifyTestAfterAPIServerRecv(string(event.Type), key, event.Object) //sieve
	sieve.NotifyTestBeforeAPIServerRecv(string(event.Type), key, event.Object)      //sieve
	w.values = append(w.values, event.Object)
	return nil
}
